session_off.message: Session total is turned off in Options

session_frozen.message: Today's total up to when tracking was turned off in Options

opt_subtitle.message: Count tokens and see the cost of every prompt in real time. 100% local — no data leaves your browser.

opt_currency_desc.message: Show cost in US dollars, or dollars + Brazilian reais (approximate).

opt_rate_desc.message: Used for the approximate conversion. Adjust it whenever you want.

opt_track_desc.message: Also estimates the model's response tokens and adds up today's spending.

opt_reset_session_desc.message: Restarts the accumulated spending counter for today only. Previous days' history is not affected.

opt_clear_history_desc.message: Removes all daily history stored in your browser (up to 90 days). This cannot be undone and is different from Reset session.

opt_clear_overrides_desc.message: Forgets the models you pinned manually for each site.

opt_how_it_works.message: How it works: token counting for OpenAI models is exact (o200k tokenizer embedded); for Claude, Gemini and others the count is a calibrated estimate (marked with ~). Prices per 1M tokens, updated on $DATE$. You can switch the billed model right in the card shown on the site.

opt_privacy.message: Privacy: everything runs offline in your browser. No text, token or cost is ever sent to any server.

opt_confirm_clear_history.message: Delete all spending history stored in this browser? This action cannot be undone.
